environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). Security group allows inbound TCP 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or request filtering. ALB access logs enabled but no active monitoring. The Flask app runs as a systemd service under a dedicated 'appuser' account with read/write access to /var/lib/app/users.db.
